title: hermes-agent
description: hermes-agent 0.19.0 — NousResearch Hermes agent (Python). This package has TWO slots: `hermes` renders to ~/.hermes/config.yaml (YAML) and `hermes-env` renders to ~/.hermes/.env (KEY=VALUE format). The `hermes-env` slot's `<PROVIDER>_API_KEY` line is a special dynamic env-var (auto-injected as the env-var name that the chosen provider's bound virtual key is stored under).

model.description: Active model. Either a bare model-id string, or an object carrying the provider selection alongside it. Hermes canonicalizes the string form into `{default: <id>}` on load, so both spellings end up equivalent.

oneOf.description: Bare model id, used with the default provider.

provider.description: Provider id. Built-ins are 'anthropic', 'openai', 'google', 'openrouter', etc. A self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint is `custom:<name>`, where `<name>` matches a `custom_providers[].name` (or a `providers.<name>` key) — e.g. `custom:litellm`. Bare `custom` works only together with an explicit `base_url`. The form renders this as a select driven by `x-provider-choices` (server-stamped from manifest.configs[].supported_providers).

default.description: Default model id. For a `custom:<name>` provider this is the id the proxy serves (against LiteLLM, its `model_name` alias — not the vendor's model name).

base_url.description: Override base URL for the provider. Required for the bare `provider: custom` form; redundant when `provider` is `custom:<name>` and the URL lives in the `custom_providers` entry.

max_tokens.description: Override the model's max output tokens.

custom_providers.description: Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible providers. Hermes reads both this legacy list form and the newer keyed `providers` map; this is the form that matches the `custom:<name>` provider selector. An entry is only usable once it has BOTH `name` and `base_url` — hermes drops the entry otherwise, and then `model.provider: custom:<name>` fails to resolve. Hermes also accepts camelCase aliases at runtime (baseUrl, apiKey, apiMode, keyEnv/apiKeyEnv, defaultModel, contextLength, rateLimitDelay) and auto-maps them, but logs a warning per entry per load; this schema requires canonical snake_case so the form emits the form hermes writes back.

base_url.description: Provider endpoint URL. Must include the `/v1` suffix for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

api_key.description: Inline API key for this provider. Auto-injected from the bound virtual key at deploy time — leave the placeholder; the deploy service substitutes the real key. Prefer `key_env` over a literal when the key is long-lived.

key_env.description: Name of the env var holding this provider's API key (e.g. 'LITELLM_API_KEY'). Read from ~/.hermes/.env, which is the `hermes-env` slot. Takes precedence over `api_key` at runtime. Snake_case alias: `api_key_env`.

api_mode.description: Wire protocol for this provider. An OpenAI-compatible proxy uses `openai_chat` (the default). Alias: `transport`.

model.description: Model id this provider serves by default. Overrides `model.default` for this entry. Alias: `default_model`.

models.description: Models this provider offers. Normally written as an id-keyed object; a bare list of ids is also accepted and normalized.

context_length.description: Context window (tokens) for this provider's models.

rate_limit_delay.description: Seconds to wait after a rate-limit response before retrying.

stale_timeout_seconds.description: Time after which an in-flight call to this provider is considered stale (seconds).

discover_models.description: Query the provider's /models endpoint to build the catalog instead of using the declared `models`.

extra_body.description: Extra JSON merged into every request body for this provider.

extra_headers.description: Extra headers merged into every request for this provider.

ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to a CA bundle used to verify this provider's TLS certificate.

ssl_verify.description: Verify this provider's TLS certificate. Set false only for a trusted internal endpoint with a self-signed cert.

providers.description: Newer keyed form of `custom_providers` — a map keyed by provider id instead of a list. Hermes normalizes it to the same runtime shape, so the two forms are interchangeable; prefer one. The chosen provider's entry is auto-populated by the platform.

api_key.description: Inline API key for this provider. Auto-injected from the bound virtual key at deploy time — leave the placeholder.

key_env.description: Name of the env var holding this provider's API key. Alias: `api_key_env`.

api_mode.description: Wire protocol for this provider. Alias: `transport`.

model.description: Default model id for this provider. Alias: `default_model`.

enabled.description: Set false to keep a provider in the config but hide it from the resolver. The entry is skipped entirely, so `custom:<name>` will fail to resolve while disabled.

api_max_retries.description: Max retries on transient API errors.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort hint passed to the model.

tool_use_enforcement.description: Whether the model must use tools. `auto` lets the model decide.

compression.description: Context compression settings (summarizes old turns when context fills up).

threshold.description: Trigger compression when context fills this fraction (0-1).

target_ratio.description: Compress to this fraction of the threshold.

auxiliary.description: Auxiliary model settings (separate from the primary model).

backend.description: Terminal execution backend. `local` runs in the same VM; `docker` / `ssh` isolate.

redact_pii.description: Redact PII (emails, phone numbers) before sending to the model.

worktree.description: Use git worktrees for code edits (lets multiple sessions work in parallel).

hermes-env.description: hermes environment-vars file (rendered as KEY=VALUE lines in ~/.hermes/.env). The dynamic `<PROVIDER>_API_KEY` line is auto-injected by the platform based on the chosen provider in the `hermes` slot.

HERMES_API_CALL_STALE_TIMEOUT.description: Time after which an in-flight call is considered stale (seconds).

HERMES_YOLO_MODE.description: Skip all safety confirmations (use with caution).
